name: Name Tag Cursor
description: Inside this area the cursor becomes a coloured pointer towing a small name tag.

props.name: title
props.description: Content of the tag that trails the pointer, usually a name. Leave it out for the pointer alone.

props.name: color
props.description: Fill of the pointer and the tag. The tag's text uses brand-foreground, so pick a colour that holds contrast with it.

props.name: children
props.description: The area where the pointer takes over. The native cursor is hidden here only for a mouse or pen.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the wrapper. Also accepts every other prop of a div.
